practicalSkillsWorkflowAgreement: Before future website motion work, create a small purpose/frequency/driver/property inventory. Use animate and review-animations to distinguish prompt UI response from explicitly requested character content; extend existing timing tokens for the UI.

Use choreograph to write a causal timeline before editing the rig: antenna notice, gaze/head attention, feet contact, head recovery and mitten offer. Mark static and supporting channels explicitly, and preserve consideration holds that carry the story.

Use animation-performance to design an active/control comparison and attribute scripting, paint or scheduling cost with a trace. Record visibility and focus. Treat SVG path updates and the night filter as hypotheses to test, never automatically as defects.

For material rig changes, combine numeric anatomy/termination/interruption checks with actual-size rendered contact sheets, exact export bounds and continuous playback of the changed passages. For the final website, add intended-device, offscreen/hidden, reduced-motion, teardown and repeated-instance checks.

Keep source invariants, sampled rendered integrity, callback cadence, perceived continuous motion and human research in separate evidence fields. Use improve-animations' evidence-based handoff discipline to give engineers specific locations, acceptance cases and unresolved observations.
Preserve frozen controls, current source hashes and both independent scores. Skills intake changes the review method; it does not substitute a checklist or consensus for craft judgment.
skillsExceptions: A multi-second authored performance remains available when Play is activated by keyboard; UI feedback budgets do not erase the requested content or equivalent keyboard access.
SVG antenna, face and eyelid deformation and the authored hop tangents have expressive reasons. Transform/opacity advice does not authorize anatomy changes or mechanical replacement with UI curves.
A fully static expressive reduced-motion state is appropriate here. No fade, stagger, idle loop or blur is added merely to comply with a generic polish rule.
The explicit independent/pair JSON workflow and no-source-edit assignment govern output and permissions. Skill construction or plan-writing conventions do not add a confirmation gate.
